product_metadata.title: InterDesign Casilla Glass Foaming Soap Dispenser Pump for Kitchen, Bathroom Countertop and Vanities - Blue/Brushed
features: LIQUID SOAP DISPENSER: Holds up to 14 ounces of foaming liquid soap in your master bathroom, kitchen, guest bathroom, kid's bathroom, powder room, craft room, or workspace. Simply remove the top and pour in your favorite brand of soap
DURABLE: Thick glass construction stays looking new for years of durable use
STYLISH: Fashionable brushed finish and transparent blue design matches a variety of bathroom decors
STRONG BASE: Sturdy base is easy to clean and prevents holder from tipping over or sliding on a wet counter
IDEAL SIZE: Measures 3" x 2.75" x 7.5" to fit perfectly on any countertop
description: The iDesign Casilla Modern Glass Soap Pump is a modern and practical accent for your kitchen or bathroom sink. The stylish transparent blue body and plastic brushed pump head of this quality holder will look good as new through years of quality use. It can hold up to 14 oz. of your favorite foaming soap for your convenience. This rectangular glass soap pump is sleek and modern with a wide opening, making refilling the soap easy! The sturdy base will prevent the soap dispenser from sliding around or being knocked over. The iDesign Casilla Modern Glass Soap Pump measures 3" x 2.75" x 7.5", the perfect size for your vanity or counter space. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
